text:
maria: CI red on hosted-integ after nightly. Streaming + auth tests failing with 401s and a tool-call schema error. Repro consistent on shard 12. @ken @devon can you take a look? pasting minimal info below

ken: on it. can you list the failing test names and a short log snippet?

maria: failing tests: `tests/integration/test_stream_tooling.py::test_tool_call_schema` and `tests/integration/test_auth_stream.py::test_stream_auth_retry`
logs (trimmed):
```
E   AssertionError: response schema mismatch: unexpected key 'metadata.order' at /tool/inputs
E   401 Unauthorized: token rejected (kid not found)
E   at hosted-runtime: auth/verify.go:87
```

devon: can we rerun shard 12 first (quick check) before bisecting? i can trigger a targeted rerun.

maria: started a targeted rerun now — command I used: `./ci-tools/rerun.sh --shard=12 --suite=hosted-integ --fail-fast`

ci-bot: Rerun started for shard 12 by maria. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/3801234601 (logs streaming)

ci-bot: Partial results: `test_tool_call_schema` failed (same assertion), `test_stream_auth_retry` failed with 401 during handshake, plus intermittent 503 from proxy.

ken: 401 text says `kid not found` — could be JWKS rotation or mismatched key caching. but also the schema error is a new key (`metadata.order`) which we didn't add. any recent PRs touching tool-call serialization or proxy?

devon: quick grep of merge window shows two merges in last 8 hours: #2218 (streaming-proxy: add x-rw-routing header) and #2225 (tooling: reorder metadata flattening). either could cause this. i can bisect if rerun can't isolate.

sarah: FYI I saw header ordering flips when proxy adds extra headers; our schema validator on the hosted side is strict about arrays->object conversions. if `x-rw-routing` is inserted into JSON envelope metadata, it could shift how we flatten the inputs.

maria: attaching failing payload snapshot:
```
{
  "tool": {
    "name": "search",
    "inputs": {
      "query": "foo",
      "metadata": { "order": 3, "x-rw-routing": "us-east-1" }
    }
  }
}
```
expected `metadata` to be `{ "order": 3 }` only.

ken: ok that looks like #2218 adding header into the tool payload accidentally. but why kid not found? separate issue or cascade from proxy change?

devon: to disambiguate: can someone run the smoke with KV cache disabled (maybe an old jwks is cached in KV layer)? env: `RW_DISABLE_KV_CACHE=1 ./run-smoke.sh hosted`

maria: kicked a smoke with KV cache disabled and with a stripped proxy header: `RW_DISABLE_KV_CACHE=1 PROXY_STRIP_HEADERS=x-rw-routing ./run-smoke.sh hosted`

ci-bot: Smoke completed: schema test passed (metadata only contains order). auth test still 401. stack: `auth/verify.go:87 -> jwks/fetch.go:44 (received empty keys)`.

ken: that indicates two independent regressions: #2218 is responsible for schema mismatch; #2229 maybe affected JWKS fetch or an upstream jwks endpoint. I'm going to run a narrow HTTP check against the JWKS endpoint used by hosted: `curl -i https://auth.internal/.well-known/jwks.json`

ops-bot: Notifying infra team: potential jwks endpoint flake observed in hosted-region us-east-1, incident stub created INF-453.

devon: I can bisect the schema change quickly tomorrow if needed. for now can we revert #2218 on staging and re-run smoke? that should fix the schema failures. would prefer not to revert anything for auth until we confirm JWKS is flaky.

maria: reverted #2218 on staging, re-triggering staging smoke now.

ci-bot: Staging smoke rerun (reverted #2218) finished: schema tests green, auth tests still 401. JWKS curl returned 200 but body had no `keys` array (empty payload).

ken: created quick workaround in auth verify to fallback to cached JWKS for 5m if empty payload seen. will open a PR for the fallback and patch deploy to staging.

sarah: also adding a small integration smoke asserting header/content shape so we catch accidental header copy into tool payloads: `assert \"x-rw-routing\" not in payload[\"tool\"][\"inputs\"][\"metadata\"]`. putting PR up in a minute.

devon: leaving a note: I'll run a bisect on #2225 (tooling flatten) tomorrow morning in case there's any remaining edge case.

maria: thanks all. summary: schema regression traced to #2218 (reverted), auth 401 traced to empty JWKS response upstream (INF-453 created). next steps: ken to patch fallback, sarah to add smoke assertion, devon to bisect if needed. :thumbsup:

ken: patch open: https://review.internal/r/ken/patch-387 — will deploy to staging in 10m.

ci-bot: Patch deployed to staging. Run: https://ci.internal/runs/3801234618

ci-bot: Staging smoke after patch: auth test now passes. marking INF-453 as triaged, leaving monitoring for next 2 hours.

devon: cool. i'll pick up the bisect tomorrow AM if anything else pops. good catch everyone. :eyes:
